tone: Atmospheric and suspenseful, attentive to ordinary clues, social tensions and human motives; never comic or sensationalized.

depictionRules.text: Show disguised characters as their disguise at that moment; do not reveal a hidden identity through costume or likeness.
Keep violence restrained and contextual; emphasize evidence and consequences.

eras.label: Late Victorian England
eras.people: Urban and rural communities with varied occupations and social positions; avoid caricatures of class or origin.
eras.dress: Tailored wool suits, coats, waistcoats, dresses, hats and workwear appropriate to the setting and occupation.
eras.buildingsAndObjects: Brick streets, lodging rooms, country houses, fireplaces, desks and ordinary domestic objects, weathered by use.
eras.technology: Gas and oil lighting, telegrams, steam trains and horse transport; no electric lighting, motor cars, modern plastics or screens.
